g.title: SBS_QSP
g.text: Short Bowel Syndrome with Chronic Intestinal Failure (SBS-IF) — QSP Mechanistic Map
단장증후군 · 만성 장부전 — 정량적 시스템 약리학 기계론적 지도
Parenteral support volume is an OUTPUT of two conservation equations (fluid, energy), not an input.
Anatomy is a parameter that multiplies capacity. The ileal-brake loop is the positive feedback that makes the disease self-sustaining.
Adaptation is nutrient-GATED, so GLP-2 analogue effect enters as a PRODUCT with luminal nutrient — never as a sum.

g.title: cluster_ETIO
g.text: the cause sets the remnant, the remnant sets everything else

g.title: cluster_ANAT
g.text: 2. 잔여 해부 = 파라미터 · Remnant anatomy as PARAMETER
these are not states; they multiply every capacity downstream

g.title: cluster_LCELL
g.text: 7. L세포 · 장호르몬 축 · L-cell enterohormonal axis — THE BROKEN LOOP
L-cells live in distal ileum & proximal colon — exactly the tissue that is resected

g.title: cluster_CAP
g.text: 3. 흡수 계수 · Absorptive capacity — the Damköhler product
absorbed fraction = 1 − exp(−k · surface · contact time): length AND time MULTIPLY

g.title: cluster_SECR
g.text: ~6-8 L/day enters the lumen before the patient drinks anything

g.title: cluster_ADAPT
g.text: NUTRIENT-GATED: the trophic signal is a PRODUCT of luminal nutrient x GLP2R occupancy

g.title: cluster_JEJ
g.text: 5. 공장 Na⁺/수분 flux · Jejunal flux — WHERE THE SIGN CHANGES
net Na absorption = 0 at luminal [Na⁺] ≈ 90-100 mmol/L; NEGATIVE below it

g.title: cluster_MOT
g.text: 8. 운동성 · 통과시간 · Motility, transit and the ileal brake
contact time is a multiplicand in the Damköhler product — this is why transit drugs work

g.title: cluster_COLON
g.text: 6. 대장 = 소화 기관 · The colon as a digestive organ
3-4 L water, 400-800 mmol Na⁺, and up to ~1000 kcal/day of SCFA salvage

g.title: cluster_FUNC
g.text: per-area transport capacity rises even when villus height does not

g.title: cluster_BILE
g.text: 11. 담즙산 장간 순환 · Bile acid enterohepatic circulation
the 100 cm rule: below it, bile-acid diarrhoea; above it, pool depletion and steatorrhoea — OPPOSITE therapies

g.title: cluster_MICRO
g.text: 12. 소장 세균 과증식 · SIBO, microbiome and D-lactic acidosis
D-lactic encephalopathy REQUIRES a colon — it cannot occur in end-jejunostomy

g.title: cluster_NRG
g.text: 13. 에너지 균형 방정식 · The ENERGY conservation equation

g.title: cluster_BAL
g.text: 14. 수분·나트륨 균형 방정식 · The FLUID conservation equation
this is the equation whose residual the central line fills

g.title: cluster_PN
g.text: 15. 비경구영양 처방 = 폐쇄 루프 제어기 · PN prescription as a CLOSED-LOOP CONTROLLER
the STEPS weaning algorithm: cut PN when 24-h urine rises ≥10% above baseline

g.title: cluster_GLP2PK
g.text: 16. GLP-2 유사체 약리 · GLP-2 analogue pharmacology
one substitution (Ala2→Gly) buys a 20-fold half-life; that substitution IS the drug

g.title: cluster_DRUG
g.text: each drug changes ONE term of the balance — and two of them change it the wrong way

g.title: cluster_IFALD
g.text: 18. 장부전 관련 간질환 (IFALD) · Intestinal failure-associated liver disease
the lipid emulsion is the dose; changing the oil changes the disease

g.title: cluster_CVC
g.text: 19. 중심정맥 접근로 = 소모성 자원 · Central venous access as a CONSUMABLE resource
there are only so many veins; running out of them is what forces transplantation

g.title: cluster_RENAL
g.text: 20. 신장 · 결석 · 골 합병증 · Renal, stone and metabolic bone disease
enteric hyperoxaluria REQUIRES a colon; end-jejunostomy patients get dehydration stones instead

g.title: cluster_MICRO2
g.text: 21. 미량영양소 결핍 · Micronutrient deficits — site-specific, not generic
each deficiency maps to a named resected segment or a named stool loss

g.title: cluster_ENDP
g.text: the registered endpoint (≥20% PN volume reduction) is a property of the weaning algorithm, not of a score

g.title: A_ILEUM
g.text: — site of B12, bile acid, L-cells

g.title: K_NOCOLON
g.text: zero water, zero Na, zero SCFA salvage

g.title: L_BLUNTED
g.text: 절제 후 식후 GLP-2 반응 소실

g.title: D_TROPHIC
g.text: 영양 신호 = 관내영양소 x GLP2R 점유

g.title: T_GATED
g.text: EFFECT IS GATED BY LUMINAL NUTRIENT

g.title: D_NPO
g.text: NIL BY MOUTH on full PN

g.title: W_FLUIDBAL
g.text: 수분 수지 = 흡수 + PN − 배출 − 불감

g.title: P_PLACEBOART
g.text: reserve is weaned BY THE ALGORITHM,

g.title: LG9
g.text: 굵은 빨강 화살표 = 자기지속 양성 피드백
